MII_IG_ICU

The official URL for this implementation guide is: 

https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-icu/ImplementationGuide/mii-ig-icu

FHIR profiles for representing intensive care unit data - PDMS data and high-resolution biosignal data - as part of the MII core data set.

extension.valueMarkdown: Use this ImplementationGuide resource as a computable definition of all the parts of the corresponding module of the Medical Informatics Initiative core data set.
Provide the computable publication unit for the MII Core Dataset Intensive Care module, enabling implementers to discover, validate, version, and apply the specification consistently.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Arterieller Druck
resource.description: Pressure measured in the device in the line that carries blood away from the pump back to the patient (arterial limb) during an extracorporeal procedure.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Atemwegsdruck Bei Mittlerem Expiratorischem Gasfluss
resource.description: Airway pressure on the ventilator measured at mean expiratory gas flow.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Atemwegsdruck Bei Null Expiratorischem Gasfluss
resource.description: Airway pressure on the ventilator measured at a moment of zero gas flow.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Atemzugvolumen Einstellung
resource.description: Tidal volume set on the ventilator: the volume of gas to be delivered with each mechanical breath.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Atemzugvolumen Waehrend Beatmung
resource.description: Tidal volume delivered by the ventilator: the measured volume of gas per breath during mechanical ventilation.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Beatmung
resource.description: Ventilation as a procedure: the period during which a patient receives invasive or non-invasive respiratory support. Individual ventilation settings and measurements are recorded with the Parameter von Beatmung profiles.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Beatmungsvolumen Pro Minute Maschineller Beatmung
resource.description: Minute volume of mechanical ventilation: the volume of gas the ventilator delivers per minute.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Beatmungszeit Hohem Druck
resource.description: Set duration of the high pressure level in pressure-controlled ventilation with two pressure levels, such as BIPAP or APRV.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Beatmungszeit Niedrigem Druck
resource.description: Set duration of the low pressure level in pressure-controlled ventilation with two pressure levels, such as BIPAP or APRV.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Bilanz Einfuhr Kalorien 24h
resource.description: Calorie intake over 24 hours, as part of the fluid and nutrition balance. The period it covers is required.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Bilanz Kalorienbedarf pro Tag
resource.description: Estimated daily energy requirement. This is distinct from measured calorie intake, measured energy expenditure and a prescribed nutrition target.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Blutfluss Cardiovasculaeres Geraet
resource.description: Blood flow through a cardiovascular device, such as a ventricular assist device or an extracorporeal circuit.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Blutfluss Extrakorporaler Gasaustausch
resource.description: Blood flow through the circuit of an extracorporeal gas exchange, such as ECMO or ECCO2R.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Blutflussindex Extrakorporaler Gasaustausch
resource.description: Blood flow through the circuit of an extracorporeal gas exchange, indexed to the patient's body surface area.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Dauer Extrakorporaler Gasaustausch
resource.description: Duration of an extracorporeal gas exchange, such as ECMO or ECCO2R.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Dauer Haemodialysesitzung
resource.description: Duration of a single haemodialysis session.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Device
resource.description: A medical device used in intensive care, such as a ventilator or a device for an extracorporeal procedure, to which recorded settings and measurements can be attributed.

resource.name: MII PR ICU DeviceMetric Eingestellte Gemessene Parameter Beatmung
resource.description: A metric of a ventilator that states whether a ventilation parameter was set on the device or measured by it. It links a ventilation Observation to the device that produced it.

resource.name: MII PR ICU DeviceMetric Eingestellte Gemessene Parameter Extrakorporale Verfahren
resource.description: A metric of a device for an extracorporeal procedure that states whether a parameter was set on the device or measured by it. It links an Observation of the procedure to the device that produced it.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Druckdifferenz Beatmung
resource.description: Difference between the upper and lower airway pressure during a ventilator breath, for example between peak or plateau pressure and PEEP.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Dynamische Compliance
resource.description: Dynamic compliance: the change in lung volume per change in airway pressure, measured during ongoing breathing with gas flow.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Eingestellter Inspiratorischer Gasfluss
resource.description: Inspiratory gas flow set on the ventilator.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Einstellung Ausatmungszeit Beatmung
resource.description: Expiratory time set on the ventilator: the duration of the expiratory phase of a mechanical breath.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Einstellung Einatmungszeit Beatmung
resource.description: Inspiratory time set on the ventilator: the duration of the inspiratory phase of a mechanical breath.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Einstellung Inspirationsdruck
resource.description: Inspiratory pressure set on the ventilator (pInsp) for pressure-controlled breaths.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Endexpiratorischer Kohlendioxidpartialdruck
resource.description: End-tidal carbon dioxide partial pressure (etCO2): the partial pressure of carbon dioxide in the exhaled gas at the end of expiration.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Exspiratorischer Gasfluss
resource.description: Expiratory gas flow in the airway measured by the ventilator.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Exspiratorischer Sauerstoffpartialdruck
resource.description: Partial pressure of oxygen in the exhaled gas.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Extrakorporales Verfahren
resource.description: An extracorporeal procedure as a procedure, for example extracorporeal membrane oxygenation, haemofiltration, dialysis or apheresis. Individual settings and measurements are recorded with the Parameter von extrakorporalen Verfahren profiles.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Gasfluss
resource.description: Flow of fresh gas (sweep gas) through the oxygenator of an extracorporeal gas exchange.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Haemodialyse Blutfluss
resource.description: Blood flow through the extracorporeal circuit during haemodialysis.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Horowitz In Arteriellem Blut
resource.description: Horowitz index (oxygenation index): the arterial oxygen partial pressure divided by the inspiratory oxygen fraction (PaO2/FiO2).

resource.name: MII PR ICU Inspiratorische Sauerstofffraktion
resource.description: Inspiratory oxygen fraction (FiO2): the proportion of oxygen in the inspired gas.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Inspiratorischer Gasfluss
resource.description: Inspiratory gas flow in the airway measured by the ventilator.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Ionisiertes Kalzium Nierenersatzverfahren
resource.description: Concentration of ionised calcium measured in the circuit of a renal replacement procedure, for example to monitor citrate anticoagulation.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Maximaler Beatmungsdruck
resource.description: Maximum airway pressure measured by the ventilator during a breath (peak pressure).

resource.name: MII PR ICU Maximaler Inspiratorischer Beatmungsdruck
resource.description: Maximum airway pressure during the inspiratory phase of a ventilator breath.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Mechanische Atemfrequenz Beatmet
resource.description: Mechanical breath rate: the number of breaths per minute delivered by the ventilator.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Mittlerer Beatmungsdruck
resource.description: Retired. Mean airway pressure on the ventilator. Use Mittlerer inspiratorischer Beatmungsdruck or Plateau Beatmungsdruck instead.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Mittlerer Inspiratorischer Beatmungsdruck
resource.description: Mean airway pressure during the inspiratory phase of a ventilator breath.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Monitoring und Vitaldaten
resource.description: Independent counterpart of the ISiK 6.0.0 monitoring profile, preserving its element rules except for the three measurement-code value-set bindings. Terminology bindings are extensible: a suitable concept from the bound value set must be used when available; concepts outside the value set may be used when it does not cover the measurement.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Arterieller Blutdruck
resource.description: Arterial blood pressure with systolic, diastolic and mean pressure as components, measured invasively or non-invasively.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Atemfrequenz
resource.description: Respiratory rate of the patient: the number of breaths per minute.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Body Mass Index
resource.description: Body mass index (BMI) calculated from body weight and height, expressed in kg/m2.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Energieverbrauch Indirekte Kalorimetrie
resource.description: Body-weight-normalised energy expenditure assessed by indirect calorimetry over a reporting period, expressed in kcal/kg/d. LOINC and IEEE codings identify the measurement and method.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Geburtsgewicht
resource.description: Body weight measured at birth, expressed in grams. The effective time refers to the birth-weight measurement, even when documented later.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Herzzeitvolumen
resource.description: Cardiac output: the volume of blood the heart pumps per minute.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Ideales Koerpergewicht
resource.description: Ideal body weight: a weight estimated from height and sex, used for example to set tidal volumes and dose drugs. It is not a measured weight.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Intrakranieller Druck (ICP)
resource.description: Intracranial pressure (ICP): the pressure inside the skull.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Koerpergewicht
resource.description: Body weight of the patient.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Koerpergewicht Perzentil (altersabhaengig)
resource.description: Body weight of a child expressed as a percentile for age, compared with a reference population.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Koerpergroesse
resource.description: Body height, expressed in centimetres. Recumbent body length and birth length are represented by their dedicated profiles.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Koerpergroesse Perzentil (altersabhaengig)
resource.description: Body height of a child expressed as a percentile for age, compared with a reference population.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Koerperlaenge
resource.description: Recumbent body length, expressed in centimetres. Measurements specifically recorded as birth length use the dedicated birth-length profile.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Koerperlaenge Bei Geburt
resource.description: Body length measured at birth, expressed in centimetres. The effective time refers to the measurement at birth, even when the result is documented later.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Kohlendioxid Produktion
resource.description: Carbon dioxide production (VCO2): the volume of carbon dioxide the body produces per minute.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Kopfumfang
resource.description: Head circumference, measured as the largest circumference of the head.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Pulmonalarterieller Wedge-Druck
resource.description: Pulmonary artery wedge pressure: the pressure measured with a pulmonary artery catheter in the wedged position, an estimate of the left atrial pressure.

resource.name: MII PR ICU MUV Pulmonalvaskulaerer Widerstandsindex
resource.description: Pulmonary vascular resistance index: the resistance of the pulmonary circulation, indexed to the body surface area.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Parameter von Beatmung
resource.description: Generic profile for a single setting or measurement of mechanical ventilation, identified by SNOMED CT, LOINC and IEEE 11073 codes. The specialised ventilation profiles derive from it.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Parameter von Extrakorporalen Verfahren
resource.description: Generic profile for a single setting or measurement of an extracorporeal procedure, such as a pressure, flow, volume or duration. The specialised profiles for extracorporeal procedures derive from it.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Plateau Beatmungsdruck
resource.description: Plateau pressure: the airway pressure at the end of inspiration while the gas flow is paused.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Positiv Endexpiratorischer Druck
resource.description: Positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP): the airway pressure that remains at the end of expiration during ventilation.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score
resource.description: Parent profile for ICU scoring systems. Scores are represented as Observations with the total score in value[x] and their respective items as components. If subitems of observations have independent medical applications or usage, hasMember can be used to implement these. This profile defines common constraints for all ICU scales and scores including sedation, pain, delirium both pediatric and adult as well as Assessments.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score BPS
resource.description: Total score of the Behavioral Pain Scale (BPS) for mechanically ventilated adults. The total ranges from 3 to 12.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score CAM-ICU
resource.description: Overall result of the Confusion Assessment Method for the ICU (CAM-ICU) delirium screening, recorded as positive or negative.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score CAPD
resource.description: Cornell Assessment of Pediatric Delirium (CAPD) - Screening-Instrument für Delir auf der pädiatrischen Intensivstation. Validiert für Alter von 0 bis 21 Jahren, einschließlich präverbale und entwicklungsverzögerte Kinder. Voraussetzung RASS >= -3

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score COMFORT-B
resource.description: Einschätzung von Sedierungstiefe, Schmerzen und Distress bei nonverbalen Kindern mittels COMFORT-Behavior-Skala (COMFORT-B).

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score Faces Pain Scale Revised
resource.description:
Erfassung der globalen Schmerzintensitaet mittels Faces Pain Scale Revised (FPS-R).
Der Score wird als quantitativer Wert dokumentiert. Im interdisziplinaeren Konsens werden neben der publizierten Skalierung 0|2|4|6|8|10 auch die Zwischenwerte zugelassen, da diese klinisch Anwendung finden.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score ICDSC
resource.description: Intensive Care Delirium Screening Checklist (ICDSC) for delirium assessment. Evaluates 8 items over a shift (usually 8-12 hours). Each item scores 0 (absent) or 1 (present). Total score ranges from 0-8. A score of 4 or higher indicates a positive delirium screen.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score KUSS
resource.description: Kindliche Unbehagens- und Schmerzskala (KUSS) - Fremdbeobachtungsskala für den postoperativen Schmerz bei Kindern von der Geburt bis zum Ende des 4. Lebensjahres. Für sedierte, beatmete oder relaxierte Kinder nicht validiert.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score Numerische Ratingskala
resource.description:
Erfassung der globalen Schmerzintensitaet mittels Numerischer Ratingskala (NRS) von 0 bis 10.
0 = kein Schmerz, 10 = staerkster vorstellbarer Schmerz. Der Score wird als ganzzahliger Wert dokumentiert.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score SOFA
resource.description: Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score for assessing organ dysfunction in critically ill patients. Evaluates six organ systems (respiratory, cardiovascular, hepatic, coagulation, renal, neurological), each scored 0-4 points. Total score ranges from 0 to 24, with higher scores indicating more severe organ dysfunction.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score SOS
resource.description: Früherkennung von Entzugssymptomen bei kritisch kranken Kindern auf der Intensivstation mittels Sophia Observation withdrawal Symptoms-scale. Der Scope dieses Profils liegt auf dem Assessment der Entzugssymptomatik, für das Delir ist das Profil MII_PR_ICU_Score_SOS_PD zu verwenden. Abgebildet wird nur der Gesamtwert des Entzugsscores.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score SOS-PD
resource.description: Früherkennung von Delirium bei kritisch kranken Kindern auf der Intensivstation mittels Sophia Observation withdrawal Symptoms-scale and Pediatric Delirium. Der Scope dieses Profils liegt auf dem Assessment des Deliriums, für die Entzugssymptomatik ist das Profil MII_PR_ICU_Score_SOS zu verwenden. Die elterliche Verhaltensbeurteilung des Kindes wird in diesem Profil nicht abgebildet, nur der Gesamtwert des Scores.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Score Visuelle Analogskala
resource.description:
Erfassung der globalen Schmerzintensitaet mittels Visueller Analogskala (VAS).
Der Messwert wird in Millimeter (mm) auf einer 100 mm langen Skala dokumentiert.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Spontane Atemfrequenz Beatmet
resource.description: Spontaneous breath rate of a ventilated patient: the number of breaths per minute the patient initiates.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Spontane Mechanische Atemfrequenz Beatmet
resource.description: Total breath rate of a ventilated patient: the number of spontaneous and mechanical breaths per minute.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Spontanes Atemzugvolumen
resource.description: Spontaneous tidal volume: the volume of gas per breath the patient breathes without mechanical support.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Spontanes Plus Mechanisches Atemzugvolumen
resource.description: Tidal volume of spontaneous and mechanical breaths together during ventilation.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Substituatfluss
resource.description: Flow rate of the substitution fluid given during a renal replacement procedure such as haemofiltration.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Substituatvolumen
resource.description: Volume of substitution fluid given during a renal replacement procedure such as haemofiltration.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Unterstuetzungsdruck Beatmung
resource.description: Pressure support set on the ventilator: the pressure above PEEP with which spontaneous breaths are supported.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Venoeser Druck
resource.description: Pressure measured in the device in the line that carries blood from the patient to the pump (venous limb) during an extracorporeal procedure.

resource.name: MII PR ICU Zeitverhaeltnis Ein Ausatmung
resource.description: Inspiration to expiration time ratio (I:E ratio) of a ventilator breath.

resource.name: MII VS ICU BodySite Observation Beatmung
resource.description: Dieses ValueSet enthält Codes für bodySites für die im Kontext einer Beatmung eingestellten oder gemessenen Parametern.

resource.name: MII VS ICU BodySite Observation Blutdruck
resource.description: Dieses ValueSet enthält Codes für bodySites von Blutdrücken (pulsatilen Drücken).

resource.name: MII VS ICU BodySite Observation extrakorporale Verfahren
resource.description: Dieses ValueSet enthält Codes für bodySites für die im Kontext von extrakoralen Verfahren eingestellten oder gemessenen Parametern.

resource.name: MII VS ICU BodySite Observation Monitoring und Vitaldaten
resource.description: Dieses ValueSet enthält Codes für bodySites von Vitaldaten sowie Daten aus dem Patientenmonitoring.

resource.name: MII VS ICU CAM-ICU Result
resource.description: CAM-ICU assessment result: positive (delirium present) or negative (no delirium)
